description: Use this when the user asks which alert emails they get from FlareWarden, or before changing them. Returns their own switches for this account: monitor_down (a monitor goes down), monitor_recovered (a monitor comes back up), ssl_expiring (warnings before an SSL certificate expires, at the ssl_expiry_warning_days), domain_expiring (reminders before a site's domain registration expires), certificate_changed (a site's SSL/TLS certificate has been replaced), issuer_changed (a certificate for the site's domain from an issuer it does not expect appears in public Certificate Transparency logs), ssl_tls_changes (protocol version or cipher suite changes), dns_failures (one switch for DNS resolution failures, changes to a site's DNS records and alerts from the DNS records the user watches), performance_anomalies (an unusual slowdown while the monitor is still up, for monitors with anomaly detection on); the master email switch; and their SSL expiry warning days. Not for webhooks or Slack, Discord, Google Chat and Microsoft Teams alerts: use list_webhooks.
name: get_my_notifications
title: Get my alert emails
